references.title: On the Shannon Capacity of a Graph
references.note: Introduces the Lovasz theta function and its efficiently computable semidefinite upper bound on graph independence/Shannon capacity.

references.title: Random 3CNF Formulas Elude the Lovasz Theta Function
references.note: Shows that the generic 3SAT-to-independent-set reduction followed by the Lovasz theta function fails to refute random 3CNF below the stated density regime.

references.title: Theta Bodies for Polynomial Ideals
references.note: Defines theta bodies, connects them to Lasserre relaxations, and identifies the first stable-set theta body with the classical Lovasz construction.

references.title: Lower Bounds on the Size of Semidefinite Programming Relaxations
references.note: Provides superpolynomial lower bounds for explicit SDP extended formulations and connects general polynomial-size SDPs with bounded-degree sum-of-squares for approximation.

references.title: A Comparison of the Sherali-Adams, Lovasz-Schrijver, and Lasserre Relaxations for 0-1 Programming
references.note: Compares major lift-and-project and semidefinite hierarchies and fixes distinctions that the C008 transfer claims must preserve.

claim_boundary: These primary sources define theta methods and known obstructions; they do not prove the new JANUS descendants.
